title: fix(formula): a flow value envelope's date-text refusal says the run fails when the value is computed

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 流程作者在流程的赋值或记录写入步骤里把日期字段当文本计算时，校验和发布时的报错原来说“条件运行时流程会失败”，现在改为说“计算这个值时流程会在这一步停下”。
2. 这一步根本没有条件，旧说法会让作者去找一个不存在的条件，这是流程报错文案的体验问题。
3. 出错时只是这条报错的措辞或代码不对，同样的写法仍然被拒绝，流程条件处的报错不受影响，回滚即可恢复原样。
4. 无。

## What changes

- `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`: a flow value envelope (`ExprSchemaHint.flowValueEnvelope`: an `assignment` value, a `create_record` / `update_record` `fields.*` value) now takes its own date-text outcome arm, `value-run-may-fail`, instead of the flow-condition `run-may-fail` arm. Its fault clause reads: "this faults wherever `record.borrow_date` holds that text when the value is computed, and a flow value that cannot be computed fails the run: the flow stops at this step and the work the flow exists to do is not done (it does not read null)." The head (what the call or arithmetic is), the fix hint, the grade (error) and the location are unchanged; both doors still prefix the value-envelope sentence.
- `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal.ts`: two codes join the closed set (params map with docblocks, `CODE_TABLE`): `date-text-call-value-run-may-fail` and `date-text-arithmetic-value-run-may-fail`. The names follow the ledger's one site-qualified precedent, `type-mismatch-sweep-run-fails`: family, then the site (`value`), then the outcome. The outcome stays `run-may-fail`, since the envelope faults only where the field holds the text when the value is computed. `DATE_TEXT_FAMILY_RE` already matches both codes and is unchanged.
- Flow conditions keep `date-text-call-run-may-fail` / `date-text-arithmetic-run-may-fail` / `-run-fails` and their sentence byte for byte (the existing per-code message pins are untouched and green).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/formula` patch.

## Tests

- `validate-date-text-arithmetic.test.ts`: a new top-level describe pins the shared entry both doors call. For an `assignment`-value source and an `update_record` `fields.*` source it checks the new code, the value clause, no "condition" anywhere in the message, and the fix hint kept. CONTROL: a flow condition over the same field keeps the `-run-may-fail` code and its condition sentence. CONTROL: the accept set is unchanged (taught shift, datetime field, no field types). The #34451 block's three code expectations move to the new codes.
- `expression-refusal-codes.test.ts`: one exact pin (code, params, whole message) per new code; the sweep gains a flow value-envelope schema so its positive control reaches both new codes. The sweep budget docblock records the re-measure (see Acceptance notes).

## Acceptance notes

- **One verdict for lint and `registerFlow`.** Both doors reach the same call. `@objectstack/lint`'s `checkDeclaredValue` and `@objectstack/service-automation`'s `valueEnvelopeRefusals` (`dag-traversal.ts`) each call `validateExpression('value', envelope, { fieldTypes, flowValueEnvelope: true })` and prefix the message. The formula pin covers that call. The door suites live outside this claim's file surface; they assert the fix hint and the prefix, never the code or the condition wording, and they stay green. A one-shot measurement through both built doors gave the same clause from each (Verification).
- **A1 holds.** No code reader outside `packages/formula` keys on the `-run-may-fail` codes for value envelopes. `git grep` of `date-text-call-run-may-fail` / `date-text-arithmetic-run-may-fail` outside `packages/formula/src` finds only CHANGELOGs. `EXPRESSION_REFUSAL_CODES` has no consumer outside the package, and no i18n pack, docs catalogue, skill or eval names these codes.
- **A2 holds.** Clause-② stays `no`. The same sources are refused at the same grade; only the code and the outcome sentence change, and the accept-set CONTROL pins this. New members of the closed refusal-code set are added under a `no` declaration, as with earlier code additions.
- **Sweep budget.** The sweep grew from 15 schemas to 16. Measured locally (4 vCPU, file alone): 192 to 225 ms with the new schema, 186 to 267 ms for the base 15 in the same session. The 16th schema stands down on every source but a date field's value, so the 16000 ms budget stands, and the docblock records the reading.
- Seen, not fixed here: `registerFlow`'s multi-refusal header always explains template braces ("Predicates … must not wrap references in `{…}` template braces …"), whatever the listed refusal is. A date-text verdict is listed under that header too. Reported to the seat as a finding.

## 席位核对

- Read first: `packages/formula/src/validate.ts` (`dateArmFault`, the `value-run-may-fail` branch; `flowValueEnvelopeDateTextIssue`), then `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal.ts` (the two new ledger rows).
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula exec vitest run src/validate-date-text-arithmetic.test.ts src/expression-refusal-codes.test.ts`. Expect 141 tests passed, including the `(#34660)` describe.
